bounds: Six scenarios: the URL host is the DNS name localhost, the IPv4 literal 127.0.0.1 or the IPv6 literal [::1], over http or https. The implementation check sends each generated scenario through fetchWithSsrfGuard and nodePinnedFetch to a real local server of the matching loopback family. The HTTPS servers present a certificate for localhost, 127.0.0.1 and ::1, so Node's own certificate check runs; the servers report the Host header and the TLS server name they received. Other IPv6 forms (zone ids, IPv4-mapped addresses), public addresses, redirects and the auth dispatcher's DNS-validated lookup are outside this model; pinned-fetch.integration.test.ts covers that lookup for an http IPv6 literal. Safety is unconditional.
